numbers.value: first order in g n / m, below 1e-3

note: Wave SI-1 (derivation, no Test Card). The legacy Topic 13 SI blocker came from a normalized Phi that needs an energy reference e0; the canonical parent action has dimensionful parameters, so no reference is free once chi is a particle. Inputs AI-chosen for scale: Rb-87 a = 100.4 a0, He-He hard core 2.6e-10 m, He II density at 1.7 K from the Topic 13 record. With the real He-He scattering length (about 1e-8 m) n a^3 is about 1e4, so tree-level GP does not describe He II; its measured first sound is about 238 m/s (Donnelly and Barenghi 1998), not the 134 m/s above. Data comparison needs an approved Test Card (see docs/meta/SI1_PARENT_ACTION_SI_DRAFT_2026-11-16.md).
